criteria.text: User Action: User selects a specific chore from the chore list or chore history. Expected System Behavior: Displays the chore details, including chore name, assigned housemate, due date, completion status, and description.
criteria.note: Team decision (Anthony, 2026-11-19): the details drop down under the chore's card on the chore list (SCRUM-7 AC11) instead of opening a screen. From the chore histories, a chore still opens single chore history or expands in place (README Conflicts rows 28 and 32).

criteria.text: User Action: User views a chore with no description. Expected System Behavior: The description area shows "No description added."
User Action: User selects "Back." Expected System Behavior: Returns to the previous screen.
criteria.note: Back is selecting the chore again (its name or the chevron): the details roll up and the list is as it was (team decision, Anthony 2026-11-19; README Conflicts row 28).

criteria.text: Error Condition: A chore has been deleted or is no longer available. Expected message: "Chore no longer available."
criteria.note: Can't happen yet: chores can't be deleted (no story). The details come with the chore list, so a deleted chore will drop out of the list on its next refresh.

criteria.text: Error Condition: The chore details fail to load. Expected message: The system displays an error message and provides an option to retry loading the details.
criteria.note: The details load with the chore list, so a failure is the list's: “Couldn't load chores.” with “Try again” (SCRUM-7 AC12).
